title: Charlie's unexplained punch-biopsy scar

tellings.quote: I have like a small punch biopsy scar up near my scrotum

plain: Charlie Foltz says he has a small scar near his scrotum that looks like a punch biopsy, the small round cut doctors make to take a skin sample, and he cannot explain it. He ties it to 1976 on the Allagash Waterway in Maine, where he places the alien abduction experience he describes to Michels. If so, the scar would be a physical mark of being examined.
